skills.text: Swift, SwiftUI, StoreKit 2 (workshop participation), Crashlytics, TestFlight, Accessibility Inspector
skills.witness: Built the sleep-timer and offline-download features in SwiftUI for the Tidewell audio app, from design review to release. Reviewed the Crashlytics report after each release and fixed the highest-volume crashes, including a Core Data threading crash on older devices. Added VoiceOver labels and Dynamic Type support to the player and library screens, testing with the accessibility inspector. Prepared release notes and ran the TestFlight checks for the fortnightly App Store releases. Took part in a team workshop on StoreKit 2 ahead of a planned paywall redesign; the subscription code itself was maintained by the other iOS engineer.
